items.title: Direct PPTX File Ingestion
items.description: Load standard `.pptx` documents directly from local filesystem paths.

items.title: Binary Buffer Loading
items.description: Ingest PPTX files from in-memory Node.js `Buffer` or `Uint8Array` instances.

items.title: Stream-Based Ingestion
items.description: Pipe incoming `.pptx` files using Node.js `ReadableStream` or web streams.

items.title: ZIP Archive Ingestion
items.description: Load archives with `.zip` or custom extensions by inspecting the PKZip container signature (`0x50 0x4B 0x03 0x04`).

items.title: Unpacked OpenXML Directory Ingestion
items.description: Ingest raw, uncompressed folder trees (containing `[Content_Types].xml`, `_rels/`, and `ppt/`) directly into memory without intermediate zip overhead.

items.title: Scratch Deck Generation
items.description: Initialize new, blank presentations completely from scratch in memory with `createBlank`.

items.title: Custom Presentation Sizing
items.description: Set custom canvas dimensions and standard aspect ratios (16:9 widescreen, 16:10, 4:3) on initialization.

items.title: Local File System Export (`saveToFile`)
items.description: Asynchronously save generated presentations directly to disk with atomic write guarantees.

items.title: Node.js ReadableStream Export (`toStream`)
items.description: Stream presentation bytes for memory-efficient piping to AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage, or Azure Blob.

items.title: Memory Buffer Export (`toBuffer`)
items.description: Export as a native Node.js `Buffer` for lightning-fast in-memory processing.

items.title: ArrayBuffer Export (`toArrayBuffer`)
items.description: Export as standard `ArrayBuffer` for isomorphic Node.js, Vercel Edge, Cloudflare Workers, and modern runtimes.

items.title: Base64 & Data URI Export (`toBase64`)
items.description: Export as Base64 strings or MIME data URIs for serverless functions, microservices, and webhooks.

items.title: Web Standards Response Export (`toResponse`)
items.description: Export as standard web `Response` object with automatic MIME type and attachment headers.

items.title: Framework Adapters (`toExpress`, `toFastify`)
items.description: Dispatch presentations directly through Express `res` and Fastify `reply` with automatic Content-Type and Content-Disposition headers.

items.title: XML & Package Extraction (`extractToZip`, `extractToXml`, `toFlatXml`)
items.description: Extract raw ZIP contents, formatted XML trees, or single-file Flat OPC XML strings for auditing, versioning, and CI pipelines.

items.title: Presentation Metadata Query
items.description: Read deck-level metadata (total slide count, slide dimensions in EMUs/pixels/points, layout schemes).

items.title: Add Blank Slide
items.description: Append or insert empty slides associated with specific master layouts.

items.title: Slide Deletion
items.description: Remove slides by zero-based index or internal slide identifier without corrupting presentation manifests.

items.title: Slide Reordering
items.description: Change the display sequence of slides dynamically (`reorderSlides`, `moveSlide`).

items.title: Deep Slide Duplication
items.description: Clone existing slides with complete element trees, shapes, and layouts preserved.

items.title: Isolated Slide Relationship Cloning
items.description: Generate dedicated relationship mappings (`slideX.xml.rels`) during duplication to eliminate relationship ID collisions.

items.title: Manifest Synchronization
items.description: Automatically synchronize slide additions, duplicates, and deletions across `[Content_Types].xml` and `ppt/presentation.xml`.

items.title: Section Management
items.description: Organize presentation structure with logical sections (`addSection`, `updateSection`, `removeSection`, `getSection`).

items.title: Slide Visibility Controls
items.description: Programmatically hide or reveal slides during presentations (`hideSlide`, `unhideSlide`).

items.title: Presentation Comments
items.description: Attach and remove OpenXML slide review comments with author, date, and coordinate positioning (`addComment`, `removeComment`).

items.title: AST-Level Run Normalization
items.description: Tokenize and assemble fragmented `<a:r>` and `<a:t>` nodes to eliminate broken regex replacements across XML boundaries.

items.title: In-Place Text Replacement
items.description: Replace single or multiple text values (`replaceText`, `replaceTextByTag`) without losing surrounding paragraph formatting.

items.title: List & Bullet Hierarchy Engine
items.description: Create and manage multi-level lists, bullet characters, colors, font sizing, and indent levels (`addLists`, `getList`).

items.title: Font Family Modification
items.description: Update font family declarations across entire text frames or specific runs.

items.title: Font Size Adjustment
items.description: Modify text size in points or EMUs across runs and paragraphs.

items.title: Color & Fill Modification
items.description: Apply hex colors, RGB values, or theme colors to text runs.

items.title: Typography Styling
items.description: Toggle bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, subscript, and superscript styling.

items.title: Paragraph Alignment
items.description: Set horizontal alignment (left, center, right, justify).

items.title: Vertical Alignment
items.description: Control text frame vertical centering, top alignment, or bottom alignment.

items.title: Line & Paragraph Spacing
items.description: Adjust line spacing, space before, and space after paragraphs.

items.title: Word Wrap Control
items.description: Enable or disable text wrapping within shape and text box boundaries.

items.title: Insert Table
items.description: Add tables specifying row counts, column counts, coordinates, and default dimensions.

items.title: Table Data Hydration
items.description: Populate entire tables directly from 2D arrays or structured JSON payloads (`updateTableData`).

items.title: Row & Column CRUD
items.description: Add, append, delete, or duplicate table rows and columns dynamically (`addTableRow`, `addTableColumn`, `removeTableRow`, `removeTableColumn`).

items.title: Cell Data & Style Manipulation
items.description: Target and update text, font, alignment, and formatting inside individual cells (`updateTableCell`, `getCell`, `getCellData`).

items.title: Background Fills & Custom Borders
items.description: Set solid background colors, opacity, and custom border thicknesses and colors per cell, column, or row.

items.title: Cell Merging & Unmerging
items.description: Merge adjacent cells across rows and columns using `gridSpan` and `rowSpan`, or split them cleanly with `splitCell`.

items.title: Nested Shapes Inside Cells
items.description: Embed shapes, icons, badges, and small indicators directly inside table cells with custom styling.

items.title: Header Row Styling & Zebra Striping
items.description: Independently target and style table header rows and apply automated alternating row background colors.

items.title: Dynamic Row Height Calculation
items.description: Compute expected row height based on cell padding, font size, line count, and column width.

items.title: Slide Overflow Detection & Splitting
items.description: Detect table overflows against slide margins and clone host template slides to paginate overflowing rows.

items.title: Header Repetition on Overflow Slides
items.description: Re-render table header rows automatically on every newly generated overflow slide.

items.title: Summary / Footer Row Preservation
items.description: Ensure designated summary/total rows remain anchored to the final generated slide.

items.title: Target Native Charts
items.description: Select embedded PowerPoint charts by name, ID, or slide index (`getCharts`, `getChart`).

items.title: 17 Supported Chart Types
items.description: Comprehensive support for all 17 chart types across standard OpenXML (<c:chartSpace>) and Office 2016+ extended schemas (<cx:chartSpace>): Column, Line, Pie, Bar, Area, Scatter, Map, Stock, Surface, Radar, Treemap, Sunburst, Histogram, Box & Whisker, Waterfall, Funnel, and Combo.

items.title: Strict Whitelist Chart API
items.description: Unified chart API surface: `addChart`, `updateChart`, `updateChartData`, `removeChart`, `clearCharts`, `getCharts`, `getChart`, and `cloneChart`.

items.title: Dual-Sync Excel Engine
items.description: Synchronously updates both DrawingML XML (<c:chartSpace> / <cx:chartSpace>) and the backing embedded Excel workbook (`ppt/embeddings/*.xlsx`) with table cleansing to eliminate PowerPoint repair prompts.

items.title: Deep Chart Cloning & Slide-Wide clearCharts
items.description: Duplicate complete chart parts, relationships, and workbooks without rId collisions via `cloneChart`, or cleanly evacuate all charts from a slide via `clearCharts` while preserving text, shapes, and tables.

items.title: Data Labels & Spatial Alignment
items.description: Inspect, toggle, and customize rich data labels with formatting, positioning (`outEnd`, `inEnd`, `ctr`), percentages, and category labels.

items.title: Add Vector Shapes
items.description: Insert basic shapes (rectangles, rounded rectangles, ellipses, triangles, arrows, callouts, lines) with preset geometries.

items.title: Solid, Gradient & Pattern Fills
items.description: Apply solid hex/RGB color fills, linear/radial gradients, or pattern fills with custom opacity to shapes.

items.title: Shape Border & Outline Styling
items.description: Customize outline color, stroke weight, stroke pattern (solid, dashed, dotted), and compound line types.

items.title: Text Inside Shapes
items.description: Insert, style, and vertically align text inside any vector shape with custom internal padding.

items.title: Shape Grouping & Hierarchy
items.description: Group multiple shapes into composite containers (`groupShapes`), inspect grouped children (`getGroupShapes`), or dismantle hierarchies (`ungroupShapes`).

items.title: Shape Mutation & Cloning
items.description: Update spatial bounds, fills, borders, or rotation in-place (`updateShape`) or clone shapes with coordinate overrides (`cloneShape`).

items.title: Remove & Clear Shapes
items.description: Delete individual shapes cleanly (`removeShape`) or clear all user shapes from a slide (`clearShapes`) while preserving master placeholders.

items.title: Add Images (`addImage`)
items.description: Add images from local file paths, remote URLs, binary Buffers, or Base64 data URIs with EMU and percentage coordinates.

items.title: Update Images (`updateImage`)
items.description: Modify coordinates, dimensions, rotation, crop (<a:srcRect>), opacity (<a:alphaModFix>), borders, shadows, or swap underlying source.

items.title: Remove Images (`removeImage`)
items.description: Delete image shape elements from <p:spTree> and safely purge orphaned relationship references from slide .rels.

items.title: Add Videos (`addVideo`)
items.description: Embed MP4/AVI/MOV videos into ppt/media/ with custom poster frames, coordinates, autoplay, loop, mute, and trim timing.

items.title: Update Videos (`updateVideo`)
items.description: Update video bounds, start/end time, loop, mute, poster frames, and playback timing bindings.

items.title: Remove Videos (`removeVideo`)
items.description: Cleanly remove video shapes, timing sequences in <p:timing>, and relationship entries without schema corruption.

items.title: Add Audio (`addAudio`)
items.description: Embed MP3/WAV/M4A audio into ppt/media/, wire audio action geometry, volume, loop, autoplay, and slide show icon visibility.

items.title: Update & Remove Audio (`updateAudio`, `removeAudio`)
items.description: Adjust audio volume (0-100), loop, start/end trim, and slide show visibility toggles, or purge audio cleanly.

items.title: Inspect Slide Media (`getMedias`, `getMedia`)
items.description: Scan slide DrawingML tree and extract comprehensive metadata for images, videos, and audio (type, ID, dimensions, positions, formats, sizes).

items.title: Deduplicated Media Cloning (`cloneMedia`)
items.description: Duplicate media shape elements with coordinate and styling overrides while reusing existing binary assets in ppt/media/ (zero byte duplication).

items.title: Slide Element Enumeration & Metadata
items.description: Extract all visual elements residing on a specific slide with normalized metadata (`getElements`, `getElement`).

items.title: Type & Spatial Element Filtering
items.description: Query elements filtered by type (`shape`, `textbox`, `image`, `video`, `audio`, `table`, `chart`) or spatial bounds (`within`, `intersects`, `overlaps`).

items.title: Element Removal & Relationship Cleanup
items.description: Safely remove single elements (`removeElement`) or clear all slide elements (`removeAllElements`) with automatic relationship cleanup.

items.title: Z-Order Layer Stacking & Container Safety
items.description: Reorder visual layer hierarchy (`setZOrder`, `bringToFront`, `sendToBack`, `bringForward`, `sendBackward`) while strictly preserving `<p:nvGrpSpPr>` and `<p:grpSpPr>` container headers.

items.title: Spatial Coordinate Engine & EMU Normalization
items.description: Standardize internal dimensions and positions in English Metric Units with seamless conversions across pt, in, px, and emu.

items.title: Boundary & Collision Detection
items.description: Calculate element bounding intersections and detect slide edge overflows or overlaps (`checkCollision`, `isContained`).

items.title: Strict 6-Method Hyperlink Subsystem
items.description: Standardized ISO/IEC 29500 Hyperlink API integrated directly into Elements: `addHyperlink`, `updateHyperlink`, `removeHyperlink`, `getHyperlinks`, `getHyperlink`, and `setHyperlink`.

items.title: Target-Level Shape & Image Hyperlinks
items.description: Attach external URLs, internal slide jumps, or slideshow navigation actions to shapes, textboxes, and pictures via `<p:cNvPr><a:hlinkClick>`.

items.title: Substring Run Splitting & Typography Styling
items.description: Isolate text substrings into dedicated DrawingML runs with custom link colors, underlines, bold, italic, and ScreenTip tooltips via `setHyperlink`.

items.title: Hyperlink Introspection & Orphan Relationship Purging
items.description: Inspect slide hyperlinks via `getHyperlinks` and `getHyperlink`, and safely purge orphaned relationship entries in `.rels` upon hyperlink detachment.
